content.comment_body: Hello everyone, I'm experiencing an issue with an [product_name] expansion module. The RUN/STOP LED turns yellow after about five to six hours of normal operation. Any advice on how to address this would be appreciated.

I've attached information from the [document]. If the RUN/STOP LED is yellow, it means the expansion module is in the initialization phase. Can you specify which [product_name] basis module and [article_no] you are using? If needed, try cleaning the contacts of the expansion module with contact spray and move the slide several times to improve connectivity.

analysis.insight_summary: The user described an issue where the RUN/STOP LED on an [product_name] expansion module becomes yellow after continuous use. Another member explained that this yellow LED indicates the module is initializing and suggested troubleshooting the hardware contacts. The discussion also highlighted the need to clarify the specific [product_name] basis module version for accurate support.
analysis.user_expectations: The user seeks reliable operation of the expansion module, without unexpected LED status changes after extended use, and looks for clear instructions to resolve the issue.
